# deps/known-malicious

New package with a malicious-package record.

A package or version added in this change, directly or through the lockfile, that has an OpenSSF malicious-package record in OSV (IDs that start with MAL-, looked up with --online, packages.online, or `ubon vet`), or that npm replaced with its 0.0.1-security placeholder (checked offline too).

- Default level: `block`.
- Levels: OSV lookups run only when lookups are allowed, and only packages from the public npm registry are sent, by name and version.
- Looks at: what the change did, comparing each file before and after.
- References: [CWE-506](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/506.html), [CWE-829](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/829.html), OWASP A03:2025.

## Why it matters

These records are confirmed by people: the package or version ran malware, usually when installed. Installing it again, even to test, runs it again.

## Flagged

`bun.lock` (block):

```text
"commanderr": ["commanderr@0.0.1-security", "", {}, "sha512-commanderr"],
```

`package.json` (block):

```json
"discordi.js": "0.0.1-security",
```

`package.json` (block):

```json
"noblox.js-proxy": "0.0.1-security"
```

`package-lock.json` (block):

```json
"resolved": "https://registry.npmjs.org/ua-parserr/-/ua-parserr-0.0.1-security.tgz",
```

`pnpm-lock.yaml` (block):

```yaml
colorss@0.0.1-security:
```

`yarn.lock` (block):

```text
resolved "https://registry.yarnpkg.com/axioss/-/axioss-0.0.1-security.tgz#0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567"
```

## Not flagged

- commander: already at the base
- prompt-kit 3.0.0: an ordinary version
- the project's own version field is 0.0.1-security; it is not a dependency
- left-pad 0.0.1 and security-headers ^0.0.1: ordinary versions
- old-helper: the placeholder was already in the lockfile at the base
- discordi.js and noblox.js-proxy in package-lock.json: reported once, on their package.json lines
- debug 4.4.2 and chalk 5.6.1: versions whose malicious-package records only OSV can confirm; offline they are listed under not checked
- is-arrayish: a new package; offline there is nothing to look up
- chalk and table-formatter: ordinary versions
- the snapshots section repeats colorss; it is reported once, where the package is defined

## How to fix

Remove the package, and if it was installed, treat the machine and the credentials it holds as exposed.

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore deps/known-malicious: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "deps/known-malicious": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
